review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-05 delegated author, E0); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-05 part E0 (the prerequisites of the first gated operation, Plan #80), tested with REAL PostgreSQL and MOCKED fault injection only where a stub gate answers a commit without an answer or a lost refresh race; no gated operation is served, no surface changes and production stays dark: the successor of the admission at cloud-release-r89. The Go sources of the center change: store-1 (migration 0007, entitlement.definitions_current, written once per definitions version by the revision that starts with it, and a replica of another version neither recomputes nor writes an account); the clock floor at the newest record or activation instant; gate-3 (access.GateFailure wraps its cause, is audited as access.gate_failure with a closed reason and is logged with the correlation ID by the failure paths of identityapi, fleetapi and the pages; the answer stays RESOURCE/overloaded); the access.Control interface with WithControls, the composition rule that every gated row has a control, and package quota (routed_calls_per_account, routed_in_flight_per_account released through ingress.Call.AfterCall, and the node channel's upgrade rate), whose numbers are identity policy keys with owner-placeholder defaults (H-07, illustrative), never plan limits; the group of feature.OperationKeys and the row check of access.CheckRow; the start's record of the definitions version. The tests and the documents are not part of the image or the bundle. No Go module, npm package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes. The Worker sources are unchanged; the Worker record follows the new profile. It supersedes the admission at cloud-release-r89.
